summary: Enforced speed limits for arriving aircraft at EGBB, falling to 165 knots on final approach.
text:
PILOTS SHOULD EXPECT THE FOLLOWING ENFORCED SPEED RESTRICTIONS 
WHEN ACFT ARE BEING SEQUENCED. SPEED LIMIT POINT 250KT OR LESS 
INTERMEDIATE APCH AREA/DOWNWIND 210KT OR LESS BASE/15NM FM TOUCHDOWN 
180KT OR LESS FINAL APPROACH BTN 8 DME AND 5 DME 165KT
